description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-16 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip 1.2, which repaired links in this skill's references and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the comprehensive UI/UX review in the phrasings the description names, including German. Near-misses share UI vocabulary and are another skill's job: the component inventory (existing-ui-audit, which this skill's description names for its inventory), a WCAG-only audit (accessibility-auditor) and building a new screen (fe-design). Counterexamples guard 'review' meaning code review and 'design' meaning API design.

queries.q: review the design of the checkout flow before launch
check the UI of the settings page — interaction, responsiveness, the lot
give the new onboarding screens a full UX review across breakpoints
does this dashboard hold up on mobile, and do the hover and empty states make sense?
schau dir das Design der neuen Profilseite an und prüf UI und UX gründlich
list every button and card component we already have in the repo
queries.note: the inventory this skill runs first, without a review verdict → existing-ui-audit, named in this skill's description

queries.q: does this form meet WCAG 2.2 AA? nothing else, just accessibility
queries.note: accessibility is one of this skill's phases, but an a11y-only audit is the narrower skill's job → accessibility-auditor

queries.q: build the new pricing page from this mockup
queries.note: same UI surface, but the ask is to build, not to review → fe-design

queries.q: review this pull request for bugs
design the REST endpoints for the invoice service
